_doc: Gates for eval/runners/eval-retrieval-ir.ts. The runner exits 1 when any `gates` value is below threshold on the `gateOn` leg. Thresholds start deliberately LOW because CI runs with EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=mock (hash-seeded vectors: the semantic layer is noise and only FTS/trigram/structured carry signal). Ratchet: after three consecutive green runs on main, raise each gate to (observed - 0.05) rounded down to 0.05, never lower a gate without a note in docs/runbooks/retrieval-eval.md.
